'''Alijha''' was a young [[Da'shain Aiel]] after the [[Breaking]].  

==History==
He helped [[Lewin]], [[Luca (Aiel)|Luca]], [[Gearan]], and [[Charlin]] free [[Maigran]] and [[Colline]] from bandits. When they killed the bandits, they were disowned by their families for using violence; a violation of the core beliefs of the [[Da'shain Aiel]].{{ref/book|4|25}} Charlin died in the encounter. The survivors become the first modern warrior [[Aiel]].

==Errata==
He is listed as [[Jenn Aiel]] in [[The Wheel of Time Companion]], but the term Jenn did not exist until after they were disowned. He should be Da'shain Aiel.

==Trivia==
* based on the audiobook pronunciation, his name is cognate with the Hebrew name {{Wiki|Elijah}}.
